column1: # The checks of shell/undeclared-password.nsh. See check-shell-log.sh.
# A PASSWORD of VarStoreId 9, which no VarStore of its form package declares, names no VarStore,
# so its password may be in any variable: get, keyword get, keyword set, list-questions and set
# read and write none, of either package list, even with --i-am-fine-to-brick-this-system, which
# lifts none of that, so set and keyword set warn of nothing, and nothing shows 0x7A4C19E3, which
# UdBacking holds where the password may be

column3: . == {"error_message": "PASSWORD question 0x0002 in FormSet 8C78A505-BAA0-4C4A-869F-000000002300: no supported varstore with matching id 0x0009 found; as the variable of that password is unknown, the UEFI Shell build reads and writes no variable of this HiiDB"}
